listings.description: About The Product: Gold Intensive Aoud by Mancera is an Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Overall, Gold Intensive Aoud is a perfect fragrance for those who want to leave an unforgettable impression. Its complexity and versatility make it perfect for a night out, an important business meeting, or just to feel elegant and luxurious in your everyday life. One thing is certain; with this fragrance, you will turn heads and leave a lasting impression. listings.description: About The Product: Hermes Jardins Miniature Set contains x4 7.5ml fragrances. Perfect sizes for trying each of these lovely fragrances, or small enough to take away on holiday or popping in your handbag. . . Un Jardin Sur Le Nil Un Jardin Sur Le Nil is a floral-fruity fragrance for women and men launched in 2005. An impressionistic stroll through the island-gardens on the Nile at Aswan, the starting point for a new olfactory adventure. . Un Jardin Sur La Lagune . Un Jardin Sur La Lagune is an amber-floral fragrance for women and men launched in 2019. A vibrant, distinctive unisex fragrance offering freshness and a dreamy vibe. Floral notes of magnolia and madonna lily along with sea and wood nuances dominate the scent. The history behind the fragrance is about a mysterious garden that an English Lord built on the water, inside a lagoon in Venice. Les Jardins fragrances attest to genuine encounters between the Hermès spirit, the soul of a place and the perfumer. . Un Jardin A Cythere . Un Jardin A Cythere is a woody-aromatic fragrance for women and men launched in 2003. Un Jardin A Cythere is an exression of an alfactory quest through Greece that leads to Kythira, an unspoilt island that has inspired so many artists. Un Jardin à Cythère eau de toilette combines enveloping notes of grasses with the strength of olive wood and the tenderness of fresh pistachio. . Le Jardin De Monsieur . Le Jardin De Monsieur is a citrus-aromatic fragrance for women and men launched in 2015. Le Jardin de Monsieur eau de toilette evokes a Chinese garden poised between reality and imagination. A place for meditation, where strolling and thought go hand in hand. Perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena tells the story of a fragrance dotted with flowers, water, trees, and rocks. Floral and vegetal, Le Jardin de Monsieur eau de toilette juxtaposes delicate sambac jasmine, tangy kumquat and explosive bergamot in a harmonious accord. . .

listings.rawTitle: YSL Y Eau de Parfum Men's Aftershave Spray (60ml) 60ml
listings.description: About The Product: Y Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Introducing Y Eau de Parfum, the latest aromatic fougere fragrance for the modern man by Yves Saint Laurent. listings.description: About The Product: Girl Of Now Lovely by Elie Saab is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. A feminine, vibrant and captivating fragrance, designed for the contemporary woman who isn't afraid to embrace her uniqueness. This intoxicating scent exudes an instant feeling of freshness and vitality, with a delightful blend of crisp mint, sweet pear, invigorating mandarin orange, earthy rosemary, resinous galbanum, and luscious black currant blossom in the top notes. As the fragrance unravels, it takes you on a mesmerising journey through a blossoming garden. Its heart comprises sweet almond notes intertwined with enchanting orange blossom and exotic frangipani, with hints of liquorice-like anise and soft, fragrant roses creating an interesting play of contrasting notes. In the base, warm, creamy tonka bean embraces the mystical aura of patchouli and rich amber, accentuated by a touch of Ambroxan, adding depth and long-lastingness to this unique composition. In essence, Girl of Now Lovely by Elie Saab is a complex yet harmonious bouquet of various aromatic experiences, effortlessly embodying the irresistible allure, confidence and elegance of today's women. It's a perfume that lingers and creates beautiful, memorable olfactory experiences, just like the women who wear it. listings.rawTitle: Color Wow Root Cover Up (2.1g) Dark Blonde
listings.description: About The Product: Say goodbye to visible roots and hello to confidence! Color Wow Root Cover Up is your go-to solution to instantly cover greys. touch-up highlight and fill in sparse areas. . This easy-to-use, precise formula delivers natural-looking results in seconds. No mess, no fuss - just flawless hair that lasts until your next shampoo. You can even swim in it!. Reflective mineral powder for a multi-dimensional, natural look Never stiff, sticky, or waxy like mascaras, crayons and sprays.. No waxes, no dyes, no PPD’s + cruelty-free. How To Use: Step 1: Apply to dry hair. Step 2. Load up small end of brush with powder. Step 3. Use free hand to pull hair flat and taut against head, and press brush down firmly into roots, starting from scalp and working out. Step 4. Do not use a sweeping motion. Step 5. Apply more powder as needed. Step 6. To extend highlights, use side edge of small brush. Lightly dust off any excess powder with wide end of brush..

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Slow Dance Eau de Parfum Unisex Fragrance Spray (50ml) 50ml
listings.description: About The Product: Slow Dance by Byredo is an Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. As soon as you take a whiff of Slow Dance by Byredo, you'll feel as if you've been transported to a luxurious ballroom where everything slows down. The scent starts off strong with top notes of opoponax and cognac, both of which are known for their warm and rich aroma. This initial burst of fragrance is enough to grab your attention, but it's the middle notes that truly captivate the senses. As the opoponax and cognac settle, Slow Dance reveals a harmonious blend of labdanum, violet, and geranium. These floral and herbaceous notes complement the previous layer, adding a touch of softness and elegance. If the first whiff of the scent felt like a strong hug, then the middle notes feel like a gentle embrace. Slow Dance by Byredo wouldn't be complete without its base notes of vanilla, patchouli, and incense. These last notes linger long after the scent fades away, creating a memory that is hard to forget. The warm and sweet vanilla blends perfectly with the earthy patchouli, while the incense provides a spiritual and mystical aura. Together, these notes create a fragrance that is sensual, calming, and enchanting. Slow Dance by Byredo is perfect for anyone who wants to indulge in the luxurious world of scent, even if only for a few moments. It's a fragrance that can be worn during a special occasion or any day of the week when you want to feel sophisticated and glamorous. Let the scent slow you down, and savour every moment of it. Fragrance Type: Amber, Woody Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Opoponax, Cognac - Middle notes: Labdanum, Violet, Geranium - Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Incense Launched: 2019.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Cairo Eau de Parfum Unisex Perfume Spray (100ml)
listings.description: About The Product: Cairo by Penhaligon's is an Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. In the bustling streets of Cairo, there lies a hidden treasure trove that exudes elegance, luxury, and mystery. It's none other than the Penhaligon's Cairo, a scent that encapsulates the city's vibrant colours, spicy aromas, and exotic spices. The scent opens up with the heady notes of Damask rose and saffron, like a breath of fresh air amidst the city's busy hum. It then slowly transitions to the creamy and warm vanilla that sweetens the scent. The heart notes of Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha add a touch of spice, reminiscent of the busy markets and the air heavy with frankincense and myrrh. The base notes of sandalwood, patchouli, and cedar come together in perfect harmony, like a mosaic of fragrant wood, taking us back to the historic mosques and their carved wooden screens. It's a scent that tells a story of a city steeped in history, religion, and culture. Penhaligon's Cairo is the embodiment of elegance, mystique, and a hint of rebellion. It's the perfect fragrance for anyone who wants to embrace their inner adventurer and get lost in the city's meandering alleys, markets, and ancient landmarks. One whiff of the Penhaligon's Cairo, and you'll feel like you've embarked on a journey to the past, and the present all at once. Fragrance Type: Amber Floral Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Damask Rose and Saffron - Middle notes: Vanilla, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Labdanum - Base notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cedar Launched: 2019

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's The Favourite Eau de Parfum Women's Perfume Spray (30ml) 30ml
listings.description: About The Product: The Favourite by Penhaligon's is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. The Favourite by Penhaligons is a fragrance that exudes elegance and sophistication with its carefully curated blend of floral and woody notes. The top notes of violet, freesia and mandarin orange burst open like a blossoming bouquet, offering a fresh and invigorating scent that is impossible to ignore. As the scent settles, the middle notes of mimosa, iris and jasmine sambac emerge, evoking a feeling of refinement and luxury. Mimosa's warm, sweet scent pairs perfectly with the elegant and slightly powdery scent of iris, while jasmine sambac adds a touch of exotic allure. Finally, the fragrance settles into its base notes of musk, sandalwood and ambroxan, bringing with it a sense of warmth and comfort. Musk adds depth and intensity, while sandalwood gives the fragrance a rich, creamy texture that is both smooth and velvety. Ambroxan, with its amber-like scent, lends a warm, woody and slightly animalistic touch that balances out the floral and citrus notes. Overall, The Favourite by Penhaligons is a fragrance that embodies beauty, grace, and elegance. It's the perfect scent for those who want to feel confident and sophisticated, whether they're at a formal event or simply out for a night on the town. Fragrance Type: Floral Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Violet, Freesia and Mandarin Orange - Middle notes: Mimosa, Iris and Jasmine Sambac - Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Ambroxan Launched: 2020

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex Perfume Spray (100ml)
listings.description: About The Product: Halfeti Leather by Penhaligon's is a Leather fragrance for women and men. Halfeti Leather is a unisex fragrance that was released in 2019. It's inspired by the Turkish town of Halfeti, which is famous for its black roses. The fragrance opens with a burst of citrusy bergamot and spicy saffron, which gives way to a heart of rich, velvety roses. The base notes of leather and oud make this fragrance a sophisticated and luxurious choice for any occasion. The Halfeti Leather bottle is as luxurious as the fragrance inside. It's made from deep blue glass with a gold cap, and the Penhaligon's logo is etched on the front. The bottle's design is inspired by the domes of the mosques in Istanbul, which is a nod to the fragrance's Turkish inspiration. Fragrance Type: Leather Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Plum, Cardamom, Lavender, Bergamot, Green Notes and Citruses - Middle notes: Cumin, Rose, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Violet and Jasmine - Base notes: Leather, Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Cedar and Patchouli Launched: 2020.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum Unisex Perfume Spray (30ml) 30ml
listings.description: About The Product: Tom Ford Cherry Smoke is an amber spicy fragrance for women and men. Cherry Smoke isn't just a fragrance, it's an experience. A statement. A celebration of someone who is unapologetically themselves. Playing with fire, bursting with the scent of dark cherry, ignited by seductive osmanthus and smouldering smoked woods. . Tom Ford Cherry Smoke is the ultimate fragrance for those who desire a bold and unforgettable scent. The combination of sour cherry and saffron in the top notes deliver an enticing aroma that will immediately captivate your senses. As the fragrance settles on your skin, you will discover a symphony of fragrances in the middle notes. The blend of leather, olive, Chinese Osmanthus, and apricot create a truly unique scent that is both sophisticated and mysterious. Finally, the base notes are the perfect combination of earthy and smoky. The woody notes create a warm and welcoming aroma while the smoke and Cypriol oil add an intriguing element of mystery to the fragrance. Nagarmothae brings the composition together, leaving you with an intoxicating and memorable scent. . Fragrance Type: Amber, Spicy Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Sour Cherry, Saffron - Middle notes: Leather, Olive, Chinese Osmanthus, Apricot - Base notes: Woody Notes, Smoke, Cypriol Oil, Nagarmotha Launched: 2022.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum Unisex Perfume Spray (10ml) 10ml
listings.description: . About The Product: . Neroli Portofino by Tom Ford is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. An iconic fragrance that perfectly encapsulates the sun-drenched ethos of the Italian Riviera. With top notes bursting with bergamot, mandarin orange, lemon, lavender, myrtle, rosemary, and bitter orange, the fragrance greets the senses with a refreshing, citrusy splash, bringing forth visions of azure Mediterranean seas. This transcends into a beautifully blooming heart filled with the elegance of African orange flower, exotic jasmine, intoxicating neroli, and the unusual twist of pitosporum. These middle notes merge to form an enticing floral cocktail that infuses the perfume with a richness and depth synonymous with an Italian summer. Lastly, the base notes of warm amber, mystical angelica, and the subtly sweet muskiness of ambrette ensure a strong, lasting finish to the perfume, anchoring it with an alluring sensuality. Overall, Neroli Portofino by Tom Ford is a mesmerizing, luxurious fragrance, replete with the perfect balance of freshness, warmth, and depth. Fragrance Type: Citrus Aromatic Fragrance Notes: - Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Lemon, Lavender, Myrtle, Rosemary, Bitter Orange - Middle Notes: African Orange Flower, Jasmine, Neroli, Pitosporum - Base Notes: Amber, Angelica and Ambrette (Musk Mallow) Launched: 2011 . .

The essence leaves an impact with its symphony of notes that enliven the soul and the body. listings.description: About The Product: . Daisy Eau So Fresh Pop by Marc Jacobs is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. A vibrant and vivacious fragrance that celebrates the youthful spirit within every woman. The fragrance bursts open with a zesty mix of lemon, lime and juicy pear, infusing your senses with an invigorating wave of refreshing citrusy delight. This spirited beginning gently mellows down to a sweet heart composed of juicy raspberry, ethereal violet and romantic rose, exuding a tantalising fruity-floral charm that is irresistibly enchanting. The fragrance is grounded with earthy moss, rich cedar, and sensual musk that add a sophisticated warmth and depth to the overall scent, lingering softly on the skin and in the memory. Daisy Eau So Fresh Pop by Marc Jacobs is a harmonious blend of fruity, floral and woody notes, symbolising a lively, dynamic woman who enjoys life to the fullest. The fragrance encapsulates the spirit of youthful energy and celebrates individuality in a playful, radiant way. This is an excellent scent for those who love a well-rounded, spirited fragrance with a refreshing citrus twist.. Fragrance Type: . Floral, Fruity . listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Pop Eau de Toilette Women's Perfume Spray (50ml)
listings.description: About The Product: . Daisy Pop by Marc Jacobs is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. A vibrant and refreshing fragrance, bringing a perfect blend of citrus, floral, and musk notes to ignite the senses. At the opening, a spritz of Daisy Pop awakens you with its delightful top notes, comprised of crisp grapefruit, fresh violet leaf, and a touch of exotic yuzu. As the fragrance blooms, you are transported to a charming garden, filled with the captivating aroma of juicy raspberries, delicate violets, and enchanting roses. Daisy Pop slowly transitions to a more sultry aroma with its alluring base notes - an unusual yet irresistible mix of pamplewood, seductive musk, and warm vanilla. These sensual undertones create a balanced and elegant depth that contrasts beautifully with the lively initial notes. With its uniquely exciting combination of ingredients, Daisy Pop by Marc Jacobs provides a fun and enchanting olfactory experience, leaving a trail of charming and irresistible allure.. Fragrance Type: . Floral, Fruity . Fragrance Notes: . - Top notes: Grapefruit, Violet Leaf, Yuzu . - Middle notes: Raspberry, Violet, Rose . - Base notes: Pamplewood, Musk, Vanilla . Launched: . 2023.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Pop Eau de Toilette Women's Perfume Spray (50ml)
listings.description: About The Product: . Daisy Love Pop by Marc Jacobs is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. A enchanting blend of unique scents that aims to spark joy and whimsy. This luxurious fragrance opens with a fresh and tart burst of cloudberry and the delicate citrus tang of bergamot, stirring the senses into anticipation. As the initial notes dissipate, the heart of the perfume unveils a tantalising duo of creamy, nutty pistachio and velvety whipped cream that lends a surprisingly decadent and comforting facet. As the day wears on, the fragrance unfolds further, revealing the grounding and lasting depth of benzoin, with its warm, sweet-vanilla resonance and the clean sensuality of musk. Overall, Daisy Love Pop promises an intriguing and joyful olfactory journey with a distinctive modernity and a soft, nostalgic touch. Ideal for those who love light-hearted, vibrant scents with an unexpected, delightful twist. . Fragrance Type: . Floral Fruity Gourmand . Fragrance Notes: . - Top notes: Cloudberry, Bergamot . - Middle notes: Pistachio, Whipped Cream . - Base notes: Benzoin, Musk . Launched: . 2023.

At the first spray, your senses are awakened with an invigorating burst of fig, subtly entwined with soft floral notes of violet and the luscious sweetness of black currant. As these elements subside, the heart of the fragrance unfolds, introducing a unique combination of wheat and delicate powdery notes, paired perfectly with the enigmatic scent of poppy. This phase brings forward an essence of quiet serenity, transporting you to expansive fields of gold. In the dry down, this perfume presents an evocative base. The woody tones of barley infuse the composition with depth, while the airy musk harmoniously fuses with a surprising, earthy note of bran, imparting an unexpected finish to this captivating olfactory journey. Poppy & Barley by Jo Malone London is a versatile fragrance that promises a sublime, multi-layered aromatic experience, truly a masterstroke in the realm of unisex fragrances. Fragrance Type: Floral Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Fig, Violet and Black Currant - Middle notes: Wheat, Powdery Notes and Poppy - Base notes: Barley, White Musk and Bran Launched: 2019 Please Note: This fragrance comes unboxed.

listings.description: About The Product: Lime Basil & Mandarin by Jo Malone London is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. An exquisite fragrance that infuses different essences to create a unique olfactory experience. It starts with refreshing top notes of citrusy lime, bergamot, and juicy mandarin orange, a burst of invigorating crispiness to engage the senses. This leads to a tantalising heart featuring the unique blend of earthy basil and thyme, which is intertwined with floral tones of soft iris and light, fragrant lilac. Perfect for any gender and occasion, Lime Basil & Mandarin is a symbol of classy elegance, adventure, and freshness. listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Pear & Freesia Cologne Spray (30ml) 30ml
listings.description: About The Product: English Pear & Freesia by Jo Malone London is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women. A luscious and golden fragrance that captures the freshness of autumn. The top notes embody a crunchy bite of juicy pear mingled with the cool, mouth-watering sweetness of melon, setting an indulgently sweet tone. These transition gracefully into a soft heart of fresh, radiant freesia flowers intertwined with the rich warmth and romance of roses. This contrasting bouquet of florals provides an invigorating complexity and a sophisticated, calming essence to the overall fragrance. Completing this charming concoction, the base notes bring an unexpected, earthy endnote. The musk lends an alluring and sensuous depth, harmoniously paired with the woodsy patchouli. A slightly tart hint of rhubarb adds an innovative twist, whilst the enveloping aroma of amber provides a warming, sweet finale. Encapsulating the spirit of quintessential English charm, English Pear & Freesia is an artfully balanced scent with an evocative fruitiness and refined floral core, surrounded by a whisper of understated elegance and sensual earthiness. This enchanting blend makes it perfect for any occasion, offering a unique journey into a verdant and blossoming English orchard with each application. Fragrance Type: Chypre, Fruity Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Pear and Melon - Middle notes: Freesia and Rose - Base notes: Musk, Patchouli, Rhuburb and Amber Launched: 2010 Please Note: This fragrance comes unboxed. .

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Peony & Blush Suede Cologne Women's Fragrance Spray (30ml) 30ml
listings.description: About The Product: Peony & Blush Suede by Jo Malone London is a Floral fragrance for women. An enchanting, sensual fragrance that entwines the gentle freshness of the apple with the opulent bloom of peony and a hint of luxurious suede for an evocative finishing touch. Upon the first whiff, you will encounter the tart, invigorating note of red apple. Its lively essence gives way to the lush, floral heart where peony takes the stage, exuding a romantically rich and vibrant character. This beautiful floral show is elevated with touches of fragrant rose, the spicy, clove-like scent of carnation, and the intense, warm aroma of jasmine. The base note of suede offers a charming twist. This elegant note contributes a refined depth to the perfume, enveloping the floral fantasy with a smooth and slightly leathery essence, adding a sophisticated feel. Peony & Blush Suede by Jo Malone London is a true feast for the senses, suitable for anyone who appreciates fragrances that combine the vivacity of fruit, the passion of floral, and the elegance of suede. Fragrance Type: Floral Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Red Apple - Middle notes: Peony, Rose, Carnation and Jasmine - Base notes: Suede Launched: 2013 Please Note: This fragrance comes unboxed. .

listings.description: About The Product: Floriental by Comme des Garcons is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. A unique and captivating fragrance that challenges the traditional concepts of perfumery. It kicks off with a burst of exotic pink pepper, followed by the rich and opulent notes of labdanum. Lastly, the dry down features a beautiful blend of creamy sandalwood and earthy vetiver, grounding the fragrance with its sensual woodiness. Overall, Floriental is a harmonious blend of floral and oriental notes, offering a strikingly unusual scent that exudes modern sophistication. Perfect for the free-spirited and the daring individuals who appreciate an offbeat blend of classic and unconventional fragrance notes. listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau Des Merveilles Bleue Eau de Toilette Women's Perfume Spray (50ml) 50ml
listings.description: About The Product: Eau des Merveilles Bleue by Hermès is an Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for women. A sparkling, refreshing, and lively fragrance that captures the enchanting and profound spirit of the sea. It carries the marine signature scent and immerses the wearer into the wild, endless ocean with each spray. Its top note opens with a juniper berry that offers a fresh, pine-like aroma and brings a rejuvenating and calming effect to the senses. The heart note of Patchouli delivers a rich, sweet and spicy aroma, enveloping the wearer in a blanket of earthy scent, which contrasts and yet compliments the fresh scent of juniper berries. Finally, a unique note of Pebble mineral closes this fragrant composition. This distinctive note conjures up images of dewy, fresh rocks by the sea and adds an edgy, raw feel to the perfume. The interplay of all these notes result in a versatile fragrance suitable for any time of the day. In typical Hermès fashion, this fragrance exudes a certain sophistication and complexity that captures attention without being overpowering. Fragrance Type: Aromatic Aquatic Fragrance Notes: - Notes: Juniper berry, Patchouli, Pebble mineral Launched: 2016

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Untold Eau de Parfum Women's Perfume Spray (100ml)
listings.description: About The Product: Untold by Elizabeth Arden is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. A sophisticated, versatile fragrance designed to embrace and express the multi-faceted nature of a modern woman. Each aspect of the fragrance, from the alluring top notes to the warm base notes, reveal something distinct and uniquely feminine about the wearer. The top notes provide a lively, radiant start with refreshing and fruity pear, spiced up with a touch of invigorating pink pepper, lush cassis, and tangy bergamot. These initial notes set a sparkling tone that stimulates the senses, introducing the deeper floral notes to come. The middle notes form the heart of the fragrance and encapsulate femininity in full bloom with the elegance of gardenia and the opulence of Egyptian jasmine. This enticing blend of florals embodies the enchanting, complex aspects of a woman's character. As the fragrance lingers, the base notes come into play. They offer warmth, depth, and sensuality with amber that radiates a soft, glowing heat. The clean and carnal nuances of musk enhance the lingering scent, while the earthy undertones of patchouli add a sensual complexity to the base, enveloping the wearer in an enduring, mesmerising aura. Overall, Untold by Elizabeth Arden is more than a perfume. It is an ode to modern womanhood, reflecting different moods and moments in a woman's life. It is a story in a bottle - subtle yet complex, sophisticated yet unpredictable, unapologetically feminine and endlessly intriguing. Fragrance Type: Floral, Fruity Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Pear, Pink Pepper, Cassis, Bergamot - Middle notes: Gardenia, Egyptian Jasmine - Base notes: Amber, Musk, Patchouli Launched: 2013.

listings.rawTitle: YSL Paris Eau de Parfum Women's Perfume Spray (75ml)
listings.description: . About The Product: Paris by Yves Saint Laurent is a Floral fragrance for women. A timeless, floral perfume that captivates with a blend of delicate and vibrant scents. It opens with a medley of aromatic top notes, encompassing fresh roses, light-hearted mimosa, green tones, a distinctive hint of hiacynth and geranium. The enchanting scent of nasturtium is mixed with the invigorating notes of orange blossom, hawthorn, spicy cassia and zesty bergamot, creating a vibrant first impression. This perfume's heart brings a bouquet of romantic flowers. It interweaves a mixture of two rose notes, and harmoniously blends them with gentle violet and fresh lily. The fragrant lime blossom embraces the heady ylang-ylang, lily-of-the-valley, and the subtly intoxicating aroma of jasmine, along with a unique touch of orris root for added complexity. Finally, it descends into warm base notes. It contains the sophisticated scents of powdery iris, a whisper of sensual musk, the soft, comforting smell of heliotrope, the rich earthiness of sandalwood, and a dash of crisp oakmoss. To round it off, the cozy sweetness of amber is blended with a deep, woody cedar note. All of these nuances come together to produce a beautiful, feminine, and passionate fragrance, evocative of a walk in a blooming Parisian garden. Paris by Yves Saint Laurent is truly a classic scent for the modern, confident woman. Fragrance Type: Floral Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Rose, Mimosa, Hiacynth, Geranium, Green Notes, Nasturtium, Orange Blossom, Hawthorn, Cassia and Bergamot - Middle notes: Rose, Violet, Lily, Lime Blossom, Ylang-Ylang, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Orris Root - Base notes: Iris, Musk, Heliotrope, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Amber and Cedar Launched: 2021.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Fame Parfum Women's Perfume Spray (30ml) 30ml
listings.description: About The Product: Fame Parfum by Paco Rabanne is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. An intriguing fragrance that exhibits a blend of classic and exotic scents. Opening with the juicy freshness of mango, a spice hint from pink pepper, and the citric brightness of bergamot, the top notes provide an uplifting and enticing welcome. These then mellow into a deeply floral and aromatic heart, with intoxicating Jasmine, earthy Patchouli, and the woody scent of Frankincense creating an intense, captivating trail. This gives way to a base that fuses the warm and rich Sandalwood, the balsamic sweet Benzoin and the animalistic undertone of Musk. This captivating fragrance offers an aromatic journey that embodies sophistication and elegance, which has become synonymous with the Paco Rabanne brand. Perfect for someone with a daring, distinctive personality who is not afraid to be unique. The fragrance lasts all day, making it ideal for both daytime and evening wear. listings.description: About The Product: Soleil Brûlant by Tom Ford is an Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Rose De Chine Eau de Parfum Unisex Perfume Spray (50ml)
listings.description: About The Product: Rose de Chine by Tom Ford is an Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. An opulent and captivating scent, designed to transport the senses to the vibrant, enchanting world of Asia. As part of Tom Ford's collection, this fragrance exudes a captivating sense of mystery, class, and exotic beauty. The top notes of Chinese Peony provide an immediate impression of sweet and soft floral aroma that is inviting, alluring, and somewhat hypnotic. This traditional Asian symbol of wealth and honour adds an unforgettable freshness to the fragrance that embodies a sense of mystique. In the heart of the fragrance is the mesmerising scent of rose, contributing to its timeless and classic appeal. The rose's traditional charm wraps around the fragrance like a velvety embrace, adding a sophisticated and captivating depth that lingers in the senses. Grounding the scent are the base notes of Myrrh and Labdanum, infusing a sense of warm, rich, balsamic-resinous charm into the fragrance. Myrrh provides a profound, sacred depth to the scent, while labdanum brings a subtle hint of sweet, musky charm. Altogether, Rose de Chine by Tom Ford is an elegantly balanced, rich, and sophisticated perfume. Its long-lasting and distinct scent has an ethereal allure, making it the perfect fragrance for those who appreciate exotic floral blends. This scent is undoubtedly a distinctive symbol of refined taste and luxurious charm. listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau de Parfum Men's Aftershave Spray (50ml) 50ml
listings.description: About The Product: Bad Boy Extreme by Carolina Herrera is an Amber fragrance for men. A distinct and powerful fragrance for men that exudes confidence and audacity. It kicks off with a punchy blend of top notes; the spiciness of ginger fusing effortlessly with the subtle citrus essence of Bergamot, creating an exciting opening that immediately captures attention. The heart of the fragrance reveals an intriguing mix of the warm, grassy nuances of Vetiver des Sables intertwined with the decadent sweetness of Cocoa. This unique fusion encapsulates an essence of earthy sophistication and raw sensuality. The base of this provocative perfume consists of a deep, potent mix of Patchouli and Tonka Bean, exuding a comforting yet lingering sensuality. Housed in a strikingly iconic lightning bolt bottle, Bad Boy Extreme embodies the rebellious spirit of the contemporary man, unafraid of embracing his individuality. It is a fragrance that transcends tradition, embracing complexity and celebrating the thrilling adventure that is the essence of modern masculinity. listings.description: About The Product: Bal d'Afrique by Byredo is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. The first whiff transports you to the picturesque streets of Morocco, filled with vibrant colours and heady scents. The sensual and slightly musky scent of Musk paired with the earthy tones of Vetiver created a seductive aroma that lingered long after I had left the room. The hint of Amber brought a warmth and cosiness to the scent, while the woody scent of Virginia Cedar added a touch of masculinity. Fragrance Type: Amber Woody Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Amalfi Lemon, Tagetes, Black Currant, Bergamot and African Orange Flower - Middle notes: Violet, Cyclamen and Jasmine - Base notes: Vetiver, Musk, Amber and Virginia Cedar Launched: 2009

Overall, Byredo La Tulipe is the perfect fragrance for those who love fresh, floral scents that evoke feelings of joy, happiness, and hope. It is a reminder of the beauty of nature and the simple pleasures in life, and it is sure to become a staple in any perfume collection. Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum by Burberry is an opulent fragrance that will make you feel like a king of the world. From its top notes to the base notes, every element has been thoughtfully crafted to perfection, making it an all-time classic. As soon as you open the bottle, the aroma of Cardamom, Mint, Grapefruit and Tarragon will immediately awaken your senses and leave you wanting more. These top notes are a refreshing and energising blend of citrus and spice that is perfect for the modern man. As you breathe in, the fragrance gently transforms into the heart notes of Lavender, Nutmeg and Cedar. The warmth of Lavender is softened by the sweetness of Nutmeg, while the earthy scent of Cedar balances out the entire composition. This stage of the fragrance is truly mesmerising and will leave you feeling like royalty. Finally, the fragrance settles down into the base notes of Patchouli, Cinnamon, Amber, Benzoin, Vetiver and Sandalwood. These notes blend together to create a masculine and alluring scent that will keep you coming back for more. Fragrance Type: Woody Spicy Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Cardamom, Mint, Grapefruit and Tarragon - Middle notes: Lavender, Nutmeg and Cedar - Base notes: Patchouli, Cinnamon, Amber, Benzoin, Vetiver, Sandalwood Launched: 2017.

listings.description: About The Product: The Elizabeth Arden White Tea Skin Solutions Brightening Eye Gel is a must-have for any beauty aficionado who wants to combat dark circles, puffiness, and signs of fatigue around their eyes. The gel is an elegant blend of powerful botanical extracts that provide instant hydration and brightening effect to your skin, while also addressing the underlying issues that lead to dark circles and puffiness. One of the key ingredients of the eye gel is white tea, a natural antioxidant that protects the delicate skin around the eyes from free radical damage. This extract also helps to reduce inflammation, promote circulation, and soothe the skin, making it an excellent ingredient for a brightening eye gel. Other potent botanicals in the gel include calendula, chamomile, and aloe vera, all of which have been traditionally used for their skin-healing properties. The texture of the Elizabeth Arden White Tea Skin Solutions Brightening Eye Gel is silky-smooth and lightweight, making it easy to apply and quickly absorb into your skin. listings.rawTitle: Bondi Sands Self Tanning Lotion Light/Medium (200ml)
listings.description: The Bondi Sands Self Tanning Lotion will give you a sun-kissed tan every time. Enriched with aloe vera and infused with a scent of coconut, this lightweight lotion will leave your skin flawlessly tanned. Inspired by Australia’s most well-known beach and a desire to make the ultimate tan accessible to everyone; Bondi Sands’ salon-quality formulas work to give you an even, naturally golden tan that hydrates and nourishes your skin. Ideal for those with a light-medium complexion and first time tanners. Australian Made. Cruelty Free. Vegan. To use: Step 1 - Exfoliate to ensure your skin is clean and free from any moisturisers. Step 2 - Squeeze liberally onto your application mitt, using long, sweeping motions to smooth over legs, arms and body. Use remaining lotion for face, elbows, and knees. Step 3 - Skin may be washed after one hour. For a longer lasting, darker tan leave for up to 6 hours before showering with warm water. Gently pat skin dry. listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne Men's Spray (50ml) 50ml
listings.description: About The Product: Acqua di Parma Colonia by Acqua di Parma is a citrus fragrance for women and men. This elegant and timeless scent is well-loved, and enduring. This iconic fragrance crafted from sunny Sicilian citrus fruits is a fresh embodiment of the traditions of Italy. At the beginning, Acqua di Parma was used to perfume gentlemen's handkerchiefs. Colonia became a real symbol of Italian chic among American and European celebrities in the pre-war (1930's) and post-war (1950's) years. Cary Grant and David Niven, Ava Gardner and Eva Turner, later joined by Audrey Hepburn, were among the passionate admirers of Colonia. From a small factory, Acqua di Parma grew into a prominent house with wide range distribution. Fragrance Type: Fruity Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Sicilian Citrus Fruit - Middle notes: Lavender, Damask Rose, Citrus, Floral - Base notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood, Patchouli Launched: 1916

listings.description: About The Product: . Scandal by Jean Paul Gaultier is a sexy, floral-oriental fragrance. Opening up with a fruity burst of blood orange, followed by a deliciously sweet heart of honey, gardenia, orange blossom, jasmine and peach, on a base of patchouli and caramel. A truly sensuous and inviting scent. Gaultier moves away from the iconic torso bottles used for many of his fabulous fragrances over the last 20 years, and uses a super chic transparent glass bottle, with a metal sculpture topper in the form of gold female legs pointing to the sky. . The TV advert for the fragrance tells the story of Madame La Ministre, a government minister by day, who enjoys the scandalous French night-life. The video was shot in Paris and features the Hungarian model Vanessa Axente. listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau de Toilette Women's Perfume Spray (30ml) 30ml
listings.description: About The Product: . Flower by Kenzo by Kenzo is an Amber Floral fragrance for women. A sublime blend of femininity and grace, inspired by the alluring simplicity and vitality of nature. The top notes open with a bright, juicy wave of blackcurrant and mandarin orange, while a delicate hint of Bulgarian rose adds a luxurious depth. The sweetly unexpected addition of hawthorn enhances the overall fruity-floral introduction. Transitioning into the heart of the fragrance, there is a captivating balance of opoponax, jasmine, and the nostalgic allure of Parma violet. The rosy theme carries through the middle, but now takes a subtler role, melding harmoniously with the other components. This heart displays the classic charm and romance associated with jasmine and rose, while the opoponax contributes an almost honey-like, balsamic warmth that's incredibly enchanting. . As the scent settles, the base notes take the spotlight with comforting, sensual tones of vanilla, musk, and incense. The musk adds an animalic note, introducing a dimension of depth and sensuality, while the vanilla is sweet, comforting, and inviting. Finally, the incense imparts a touch of mystique, resonating with spirituality and serenity, bringing the entire perfume journey full circle. . . Fragrance Type: . Floral . . Fragrance Notes: . - Top notes: Blackcurrant, Hawthorn, Bulgarian Rose, Mandarin Orange. - Middle notes: Opoponax, Jasmine, Parma Violet, Rose. - Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Incense . Launched: . 2000.

listings.description: About The Product: Experience the next generation in self tan with Bondi Sands Aero, an Aerated Self Tanning Foam. Australian Made. Cruelty Free. Vegan. To Use: Step 1 - Exfoliate to ensure your skin is clean and free from any moisturisers. Step 2 - Apply Bondi Sands Aero liberally to a tanning mitt before using long, sweeping motion to legs, arms and body. Use remaining residue on tanning mitt for face, elbows and knees. Step 3 - Leave on skin for at least 6 hours. Shower with warm water and gently pat skin dry. For the deepest tan re-apply Bondi Sands Aero 30 minutes after application..

listings.rawTitle: Paloma Picasso Eau de Parfum Women's Perfume Spray (30ml) 30ml
listings.description: About The Product: Paloma Picasso by Paloma Picasso is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. An exquisite perfume that exudes an air of sophistication and refinement.. . The scent begins with a burst of bright and zesty top notes that are comprised of Carnation, Coriander, Rose, Angelica, Neroli, Bergamot and Amalfi Lemon. This combination creates an initial sensation that is both sweet and tangy, giving you an instant sense of vitality and energy. As the perfume begins to settle on the skin, the middle notes become more prominent.. . A perfect balance of Patchouli, Hyacinth, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Mimosa emerge, weaving together a lush tapestry of floral and woody tones. These notes evoke a sense of elegance and poise that perfectly captures the essence of Paloma Picasso herself.. . Finally, the fragrance fades into its base notes of Oak moss, Civetta, Castoreum, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Musk and Amber. These deeper notes provide a sensual and lingering finish, making it impossible to forget the enchanting scent of Paloma Picasso. . . Fragrance Type: . Chypre Floral . Fragrance Notes: . - Top notes: Carnation, Coriander, Rose, Angelica, Neroli, Bergamot and Amalfi Lemon - Middle notes: Patchouli, Hyacinth, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Mimosa . - Base notes: O ak moss, Civetta, Castoreum, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Musk and Amber . Launched: 1984.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Nomade Eau de Parfum Women's Perfume Spray (20ml) 20ml
listings.description: About The Product: Chloe Nomade Eau de Parfum for women is a uplifting, feminine and modern fragrance. It is described as a floral-chypre perfume, meaning it has a floral yet warming and woody sense to it.. Chloe Nomade is perfectly balanced with fresh, floral notes and a woody influence for an empowering perfume that remains overtly womanly. A combination of strong, modern notes contrasts with the soft and delicate curved bottle, adorned with a dangling pink ribbon for an elegant finish.. Nomade by Chloe is composed of sweet Mirabelle plum combined with citrus bergamot and lemon notes, before opening to a flowery heart of freesia, jasmine, peach and rose. Chloe Nomade finishes on a bold, earthy base of oakmoss, patchouli, amber and sandalwood. This fragrance is designed to contrast to the brand’s Signature perfume, with something a little more adventurous for the senses. . Fragrance Type: Woody, Citrus. Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Mirabelle Plum, Bergamot, Lemon - Middle notes: Freesia, Jasmine, Peach, Rose - Base notes: Oakmoss, Amber, Patchouli, Sandalwood. Launched: 2018.

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Pleasures Eau de Parfum Women's Perfume Spray (15ml) 15ml
listings.description: About The Product: . Created by the design house of Estee Lauder in 1995. Pleasures set the trend for uplifting, airy fragrances and introduced the Sheer Floral fragrance type.. Evelyn Lauder created it to have a sheer, elusive, luminous quality. Fresh as flowers after a spring rain, this sheer, shimmering floral scent is a refreshing blend of lilies, white peonies and jasmine, all tingling with the rare essence of exotic baie rose with a hint of sandalwood.. Never sweet, ever fresh, it will delights the senses with pleasure after pleasure. This wonderful fragrance has been one of best selling fragrances for many years. "Whatever the fragrance was to be, I wanted it to have an elusive, textural quality," said Evelyn Lauder. "And we have achieved it with Estée Lauder Pleasures. For the first time, there is a fragrance that unfolds like a flower in the warmth of the sun, surrendering its scent little by little.". . Recommended for daytime wear.. . Fragrance Type: . Floral. . Fragrance Notes: . - Top notes: White Lily, Violet Leaves, Green Accents. - Middle notes: Black Lilac, White Peony, Karo-Karounde Blossoms, Baie Rose, Pink Rose, Jasmine. - Base notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli. . Launched: . 1995.

listings.rawTitle: Cerruti 1881 Pour Homme Men's Eau de Toilette Aftershave Spray (25ml) 25ml
listings.description: About The Product: The Italian fashion house Cerruti expanded its collections to include Cerruti 1881, its fragrance line. Cerruti 1881 Pour Homme was launched in 1990, with a sophisticated and aromatic fragrance. An ideal choice for the stylish and confident man, the aftershave is housed in a simple yet memorable bottle.. Cerruti 1881 Pour Homme is a refined and fresh aftershave, reminiscent of days on the Mediterranean. With a lively start, the aftershave opens with notes of blackcurrant, used for the first time in a man’s fragrance. Alongside juniper and cypress, Cerruti 1881 Pour Homme has a woody fougère opening. The heart of the fragrance combines ylang-ylang and patchouli for depth, along with lily-of-the-valley and cassia. The aftershave finishes on a woody base of sandalwood, pine and oak moss.. Fragrance Type: Fresh. Fragrance Notes: - Top notes: Blackcurrant, Juniper, Cypress, Lavender - Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Patchouli, Lily-of-the-Valley, Cassia - Base notes: Sandalwood, Pine, Oak Moss. Launched: 1990.

listings.description: About The Product: Launched in 2005, Euphoria by Calvin Klein has been a firm favourite ever since. Its provocative and sensual fragrance takes inspiration from the exotic orchid, creating a mysterious yet feminine perfume. listings.description: About The Product: Launched in 2017, Gucci Bloom is creative director Alessandro Michele's first fragrance for the House.
